item.title: The Edge: "Barker's Beauties" describe harassment at The Price is Right - WCCB Charlotte
item.description: CHARLOTTE, N.C.- A brand-new documentary is pulling back the curtain on The Price is Right- and what it reveals isn’t all glitz and giveaways. Former models, once known as “Barker’s Beauties,” are speaking out, alleging a toxic culture behind the scenes. Complaints include racism, sexual harassment, and retaliation. item.description: Tuesday brings a big cooldown that you’ll feel right away.
